$comment: Feature ledger. status: planned | in-progress | verified | blocked. A feature is verified only when `evidence` cites a check result recorded against the current code (see .harness/evidence/). Changing the code that a feature depends on resets it to in-progress until re-verified.

features.title: Content ingestion and validation from official USCIS banks
features.requirement: Reproducible ingestion of the 2008 (100) and 2025 (128) banks with hashes, stable IDs, answer variants, required counts, special-bank membership, dynamic-answer rules and provenance; validator exits nonzero on any failure.
acceptance: pnpm content:ingest regenerates packs deterministically
pnpm content:validate passes: 128/20, 100/20, hashes match SOURCES.json
Dynamic answers are flagged and carry an official lookup URL

features.title: Test-path routing (filing date, unknown, special consideration)
features.requirement: Pure logic selects 2008 vs 2025 by filing date with the 2025-10-20 boundary; unknown stays unknown; 65/20 selects the designated 20; user can correct the path.
acceptance: Unit tests for 2025-10-19 vs 2025-10-20, null date, timezone-safe date-only handling
Setup screen explains the applicable path and allows correction

features.title: Guest onboarding and Setup
features.requirement: Guest entry without an account; ask filing date or 'I'm not sure', optional state, optional interview date, 65/20 question; link exception guidance without deciding eligibility.
acceptance: Playwright: fresh visitor completes setup and lands on Today
Profile persists across reload

features.title: Today screen with daily plan
features.requirement: Shows selected bank, due review count, a few new questions, one practical task, one prominent start button, countdowns derived only from entered dates; first-time and returning states.
acceptance: Playwright: first-time and returning Today states render correctly
No countdown shown when no interview date entered

features.title: Recall-first practice cards with self-assessment
features.requirement: Question shown before answer; reveal; correct/incorrect/uncertain; records method, hinted flag, question revision; duplicate submits do not double count.
acceptance: Unit test: duplicate attempt id stored once
Playwright: complete a card and see the attempt in history

features.title: Deterministic review scheduler and daily workload
features.requirement: Documented interval ladder, injectable clock, due items, catch-up after missed days without punishment, hinted recall does not advance mastery.
acceptance: Unit tests cover interval advancement, uncertain demotion, hinted no-advance, missed-day catch-up cap

features.title: Topic browsing, bookmarks, weak-question review, multiple-choice mode
features.requirement: Browse by section, bookmark, review weak/uncertain questions, optional multiple-choice mode recorded as recognition not recall; dynamic questions excluded from MC.
acceptance: Playwright: browse topics, bookmark, run MC mode; attempt records method=multiple-choice

features.title: Mock test state machine
features.requirement: Configured path, seeded selection, active, pause/resume, stop rules (2025: 12 correct or 9 incorrect; 2008 and 65/20: 6 correct or 5 incorrect), results, follow-up review; reports attempted count and method.
acceptance: Unit tests for both paths, special, pass/fail/early-stop, resume
Playwright: complete a mock and see results

features.title: Interview English exercises
features.requirement: Reading, writing (dictation), instruction comprehension and N-400 vocabulary/conversation prompts; self-assessed; never invents personal answers.
acceptance: Playwright: complete one task of each kind; results labeled self-reported

features.title: Readiness indicators from stored events
features.requirement: Coverage, delayed unprompted recall (numerator/denominator/delay/method), recent mocks with dates, English tasks (self-reported), uncertain answers; explicit empty state; no pass probability.
acceptance: Unit tests for each indicator and the empty state
UI shows definitions and dates

features.title: Journey milestones
features.requirement: Editable manual milestones: filed, receipt, biometrics attended/reused, interview, continuation/retest, decision, oath; alternative outcomes; rescheduling; approval separate from oath; user-entered label.
acceptance: Playwright: add, edit, reschedule milestones; biometrics reuse and retest branches

features.title: Stage guide and checklists with reminders and .ics export
features.requirement: Stage-based original guidance with official links and review metadata; tasks expand/complete/get a reminder; in-app due reminders; .ics export; no background-notification promise.
acceptance: Playwright: complete a task, set a reminder, download .ics
Validator checks guide sources are official domains

features.title: Settings: preferences, path correction, export, reset, deletion
features.requirement: Text size and audio preferences, reminder categories, test-path correction, optional dates, download status, JSON export, reset, deletion.
acceptance: Playwright: export produces JSON with attempts; reset clears; deletion clears local data

features.title: Guest persistence in IndexedDB
features.requirement: Profile, attempts, review state, mocks, milestones, checklist, reminders survive reload; stable event IDs.
acceptance: Playwright: reload preserves profile and attempts

features.title: Optional accounts (Better Auth, email/password)
features.requirement: Register, login, logout, session handling, per-user isolation; dev mail sink for verification/reset; production mail documented.
acceptance: Playwright: sign up, sign out, sign in; second user cannot read first user's data

features.title: Consented migration and idempotent sync
features.requirement: Joining an account asks consent to migrate guest progress; outbox with stable event IDs; failure/retry state visible; sign-out clears private cache; deletion covers local, synced and derived data.
acceptance: Unit test: replaying the same event twice stores one record
Playwright: migrate guest progress, sign out, verify cache cleared

features.title: Audio via browser speech synthesis with fallback
features.requirement: Play question/answer with availability and error handling; readable text always available; speed control; no offline-audio promise.
acceptance: Playwright: audio control renders a disabled/explanatory state when synthesis is unavailable

features.title: PWA manifest, service worker, offline content
features.requirement: Manifest and icons; service worker caches app shell and content packs after explicit download; cold offline reload works; auth and sync endpoints never cached; queued progress syncs on reconnect.
acceptance: Playwright: download content, go offline, reload, practice still works
sw.js excludes /api/auth and /api/sync

features.title: Dynamic (changing) answers handled without guessing
features.requirement: Officeholder/state/district questions show an official lookup, let the learner record a confirmed answer with region and date, remain unscored until confirmed, and are excluded from multiple choice.
acceptance: Playwright: dynamic question shows lookup link and confirm form; unconfirmed is unscored in mock

features.title: Accessibility baseline
features.requirement: WCAG 2.2 AA target: axe checks on core pages, keyboard navigation, visible focus, labels, 390 px layout, reduced motion, text resizing.
acceptance: axe reports no serious/critical violations on Today, Practice, Mock, Journey, Settings
Playwright keyboard flow through a card

features.title: Security and privacy controls
features.requirement: Input validation (zod), authorization on every private route, secure cookies, origin checks, request limits, no SSN/A-number/N-400 collection, redacted logs, no secrets in bundles.
acceptance: Unit tests: sync rejects unauthenticated and foreign-user events
Headers include CSP and no-store for private responses

features.title: Verification runner, CI, Docker deployment
features.requirement: pnpm verify runs validate, typecheck, lint, unit, build, e2e with nonzero exit on required failure and records evidence; GitHub Actions CI; Dockerfile and compose with persistent volume; backup/restore guide.
acceptance: pnpm verify writes .harness/evidence/latest.json
docker compose config validates

features.title: Internationalization structure (English only shipped)
features.requirement: Message catalogue structure with English; no language selector offered until a reviewed translation exists.
acceptance: No language selector in UI; messages loaded from catalogue

features.title: Content pack versioning, integrity and correction reports
features.requirement: Attempts retain pack version; integrity check command; update/rollback documented; in-app 'report a problem with this answer' stored locally and exportable.
acceptance: Attempt records include packVersion
Correction report saved and included in export

features.title: Release readiness: free production mail (Brevo, Resend), password reset, startup config guard, container deployment (Cloudflare Tunnel or Caddy), legal pages (app and GitHub Pages), expert-review gate with PDF packet
features.requirement: The four owner gates (content review, mail provider, hosting with HTTPS, privacy policy and terms) are implemented as far as software can: a real mail transport, a working forgot-password flow, a startup guard for unsafe production configuration, a tested container deployment with automatic HTTPS, drafted legal pages that stay marked Draft until a lawyer signs off, a review-record gate bound to content hashes, and one command that lists the gates still open.
acceptance: Resend transport and sink unit-tested; mail failure never blocks sign-up and never logs an address
Browser test: emailed reset link sets a new password, old password and used link stop working
Unit tests: production config refuses weak secret, non-https public URL and half-configured mail
Docker smoke test in CI: stack becomes healthy and a sign-up writes to the database as the unprivileged user
Privacy notice and Terms reachable from Welcome, sign-up and Settings, show Draft until LEGAL_REVIEWED_ON, pass the accessibility sweep
Review records bound to content hash; validator rejects unreviewed claims and stale records
pnpm release:check lists open gates and exits nonzero while any is open
Brevo and Resend transports unit-tested against mocked calls; sender parsing validated
Cloudflare Tunnel and Caddy compose overlays validate in CI; trusted client IP header configurable and validated
Privacy notice and Terms text shared by the app and the static GitHub Pages build, covered by rendering tests
pnpm content:review-packet writes a PDF with check boxes, comment columns and a sign-off page
Backup and restore scripts: online backup with integrity check, rotation, optional off-machine copy; restore keeps the replaced database; round trip verified against a running container

iPhone: tested on the iOS 26.5 simulator in Safari and as a Home Screen app; date fields, dark page background and home-indicator spacing fixed; Home Screen tip states that installed apps start empty and how an account carries progress

features.title: Native iPhone app (SwiftUI) with parity: guest study, official content, mocks, interview English, journey and guide, readiness, settings, local reminders, on-device speech, optional accounts and sync
features.requirement: A native iOS app that follows the same rules and content as the web app, works fully without an account, and can sign in to the same server and sync with consent.
acceptance: Core Swift package ports the domain rules; swift test passes, including bit-for-bit mock selection parity with the web generator
The app bundles the same content JSON files as the web app

UI tests on the simulator: setup chooses the test from the filing date, a practice card reveals and grades, the sample walkthrough stops at 4 correct, journey, guide toggle with undo, settings reset and typed DELETE
UI test against the local server: sign up, consented migration, sync, delete account, all with a bearer token
Browser test: bearer token works from a fresh context, unsigned and missing tokens get 401, the token stops working after account deletion
Sync server accepts every outbox type both clients produce, including journey
Light and dark walkthrough screenshots of Today, Practice, Interview and Journey
Privacy notice covers the iPhone app: on-device storage and speech, local reminders, Keychain sign-in
CI workflow runs the Swift tests and the UI tests on a macOS runner

features.title: Speech transcription and feedback provider
features.requirement: Feature-flagged, consent, server-side keys, inconclusive outcomes, retention controls; no fake results without credentials.
acceptance: Adapter contract and tests; UI shows self-assessment when provider disabled

features.title: USCIS case status synchronization
features.requirement: Adapter contract and tests only until organization approval and credentials exist; manual journey remains complete.
acceptance: Contract tests pass; no live calls without configuration

features.title: Payments (test-mode coaching access)
features.requirement: Only with provider configuration: server-verified entitlement, idempotent webhooks; otherwise checkout omitted and documented.
acceptance: Checkout absent when unconfigured; documentation lists required configuration

features.title: Push reminders
features.requirement: Optional delivery with consent, subscription management and a real scheduler; in-app/ICS reminders remain usable without it.
acceptance: Not built unless VAPID keys and a scheduler are configured

features.title: Additional reviewed translations, helper/class tools, Android app
features.requirement: Out of scope for this build.
